activities.anchor: 1880s to the present, and its logic is cumulative
activities.caption: rebuild the cascade — each move answers the last
activities.name: mcaCascadeOrder

config.prompt: The period is a chain of answers, not a list of styles — rebuild it:
items: Dada answers the First World War
the global contemporary answers the whole Euro-American story
config.why: Cumulative, not sequential: every wildest-looking work is a move in an intelligible game — read the question each move was answering.

activities.caption: bet first — what does the real scrap do?
activities.name: mcaPapierPredict

config.q: Braque pastes a real printed wallpaper scrap into a charcoal drawing (1912). What does the REAL scrap do that a painted imitation of newsprint cannot?
choices: Nothing — a painted imitation would look identical to the viewer
It carries actual dates and prices — the outside world physically enters the picture
It raises the painting's value by using costly materials
config.why: The scrap is simultaneously flat paper (painting telling the truth about its flatness) and a fake table top (painting lying as usual) — and because it is real print, the world's dates and prices enter the picture for the first time since antiquity.

activities.anchor: re-ran the same move with a new material
activities.caption: pair each artist with the material that became the argument
activities.name: mcaMaterialMatch

config.prompt: Each decade re-ran one move — pair the artist with the material-as-argument:

pairs.right: pasted wood-grain wallpaper — the first papier collé
industrial house paint, a stick, unprimed canvas on the floor
the silkscreen — the reproduction technique itself

config.why: The readymade asks what framing makes art; the drip makes the canvas a record of a body moving in time; the silkscreen paints the machine look the shelves actually showed.

activities.caption: true or false — 'I could do that'
activities.name: mcaSkillJudge

statements.s: Pollock's drips are controlled layering built over months — he said he could control the flow, and the films show it.
statements.why: The films of him working matter as much as the canvases: the painting is a record of a body moving in time.

statements.s: Warhol's silkscreens were machine-stamped with no hand decisions involved.
statements.why: They are tuned, re-registered and re-inked by hand — the machine look is manufactured.

statements.s: 'I could do that' is a valid criticism, because technique-free equals skill-free.
statements.why: The skill moved from the wrist to the decision — choosing what counts as the work is itself a craft, and you did not think of it first.

statements.s: Fountain's rejection by the 'reject nothing' jury disproved the readymade's claim.
statements.why: The opposite — the board's refusal proved Duchamp's point about institutional framing better than any display could.

activities.anchor: sometimes the audience is the material
activities.caption: file the encounters — material or objector?
activities.name: mcaAudienceBuckets

config.prompt: Two ways a public meets a work — file each fact:

items.label: seventy-two objects, six hours — whatever the public does is the work
feather, honey, scissors, a loaded gun on one table (Naples, 1974)
the public's choices become part of the piece's history
office workers petition against twelve feet of curved steel in their plaza
hearings follow, and in 1989 the work is cut up in storage
site-specific sculpture cannot be relocated without being destroyed

config.why: Rhythm 0 makes behaviour the medium; Tilted Arc shows the audience's refusal entering the piece's history. Contemporary purpose is an offer the viewer must answer.

activities.caption: run the hang — three ways to label a borrowing
activities.name: mcaHangBranch

config.root: You are re-hanging Les Demoiselles d'Avignon today. The Trocadéro carvings that fed it are in your hands.

start.text: How do the labels treat the source objects?

choices.label: As anonymous raw material, under the banner of 'affinity'
As works by named artists, with their own histories
choices.feedback: The correction the discipline eventually made.

choices.label: Not at all — let the masterpieces speak for themselves

affinity.text: McEvilley's review asked what the hang refused to: the affinities ran one direction only, the loans displayed as anonymous raw material — the show is now studied for its consequences, not its contents.

named.text: The borrowings get read honestly: the cultures that made the source objects were, at that exact moment, having them taken — attribution is the minimum honest frame.

omit.text: 'Primitivism' stays the period's own word, unexamined — and part of reading modern art is noticing what it was blind to.

config.why: A museum hang is an argument, and an argument is a document of its time — reading it so is the unit's transferable skill.

activities.anchor: The field formalised that critique in a museum itself
activities.caption: drag the divider — one exhibition, two readings
activities.name: mcaAffinityCompare

config.prompt: Same walls, same objects — drag between the two readings of MoMA 1984:

before.label: The 1984 banner: 'affinity'
before.text: Modernist masterpieces hung beside the masks and figures that fed them, framed as timeless kinship — scholarship treating the non-Western objects as fuel.

after.label: McEvilley's review
after.text: The affinities ran in one direction only; loans shown as anonymous raw material rather than works by artists; the hang crystallised the postcolonial critique that reshaped collecting and programming for decades.

config.why: The object did not change; the reading did. The show is studied less for its contents than for its consequences.

activities.anchor: abstraction was never a Western monopoly
activities.caption: call the magnitude — a century of biennales
activities.name: mcaBiennaleEstimate

config.prompt: The Venice Biennale began in 1895; Gwangju's began in 1995. Roughly how many years separate the two?
config.why: Exactly a century: São Paulo (1951), Gwangju (1995) and Shanghai (1996) joined Venice and Documenta before Documenta11 (2002) reconceived the mega-exhibition as a worldwide argument.
config.context: Papunya Tula artists began painting on board and canvas in 1971 — Western Desert mapping systems make Mondrian's grids look local rather than universal.
